CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to Cinder main config file

DAEMON.description: Full path to the daemon binary

PROJECT_NAME.description: The OpenStack project name; determines config/log paths and systemd service names

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group for the daemon user

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user to run the daemon as

USE_SYSLOG.description: Whether to log to syslog instead of file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to config file containing uWSGI bind settings (e.g., IP/port)

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Key in uWSGI bind config for IP binding

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Key in uWSGI bind config for port binding

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section in uWSGI bind config file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Key in uWSGI bind config for worker count

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to uWSGI application-specific .ini file (if using uWSGI)

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to uWSGI .ini file (if using uWSGI); if not set, fallback to direct binary

UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for uWSGI to bind to (if using uWSGI); overrides ini config if set
